about_the_game:
Welcome to the Jingle!

You’re Santa. You bowl. The elves react.

Jingle Strike VR combines the satisfying feel of real-physics bowling with absurd holiday cheer. Every throw has true weight and impact—you’ll feel it when you crush a strike (and hear about it from the elves when you don’t).

Bowl across four festive lanes lit with snow, lights, and laughter. The elves cheer, jeer, and sometimes… fart. Throw snowballs, gifts, or even bowling pins at them—they’ll always react in new and surprising ways.

Need a break from the Christmas chaos? Step into the 85 Second Slam-Down, a high-speed arcade mode with no holiday décor—just lights, music, and pure bowling mayhem.

Play solo or pass the headset for up-to-five-player couch VR. Perfect for family nights, office parties, or a quick festive laugh.

Features

  • 🎅 Four Festive Lanes – from Santa’s Workshop to Candy Cane Lane (with more holiday mayhem planned!)

  • 🎳 Real Physics Bowling – every throw feels solid, natural, and satisfyingly weighty

  • 🔥 85 Second Slam-Down Mode – a fast, competitive, non-Christmas arcade challenge

  • 🏆 Built-in Leaderboards – track Top Bowlers and Slam-Down Champions

  • 📸 Pin Cam – cinematic close-ups featuring hilarious elf strike & spare animations

  • 🥤 Complimenting Soda Machine – grab a drink … and a compliment between frames

  • 🎁 Throwables & Reactions – hurl snowballs, gifts, and pins at mischievous elves

  • 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Solo or 5-Player Couch VR Play – perfect for gatherings or holiday parties

  • 🎄 Family-Friendly Fun – festive, funny, and suitable for all ages

Just don’t take it too seriously—the elves (and the soda machine) certainly won’t.

name: Jingle Strike VR

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-9400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 (6 GB) / AMD Radeon RX 580 (6 GB)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • VR Support: Requires a VR headset (Meta Quest 2/3 via Link, PS VR2 with PC adapter, or equivalent), USB 3.0, DisplayPort
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-10700K / AMD Ryzen 7 3700X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2070 / AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT (8 GB+)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • VR Support: Requires a VR headset (Meta Quest 2/3 via Link, PS VR2 with PC adapter, or equivalent), USB 3.0, DisplayPort
